title: Lion cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='33' fill='#e07b1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='33' fill='none' stroke='#f7a544' stroke-width='4' stroke-dasharray='7 6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='24' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='33' r='8' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='33' r='4' fill='#d98f5a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='33' r='8' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='33' r='4' fill='#d98f5a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='48' rx='4.5' ry='5.5' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='48' rx='4.5' ry='5.5' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='46' r='1.7' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='46' r='1.7' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffe6b3'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M45 58 Q50 54 55 58 Q50 63 45 58 Z' fill='#c96a4a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 62 L50 66' stroke='#b5774a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 66 Q45 70 41 66' stroke='#b5774a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 66 Q55 70 59 66' stroke='#b5774a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='58' r='3' fill='#f79a6e' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58' r='3' fill='#f79a6e' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='61' r='1' fill='#b5774a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='65' r='1' fill='#b5774a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='61' r='1' fill='#b5774a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='65' r='1' fill='#b5774a'/>
</svg>
